name: giscraft
description: L3 native egui clone (QGIS muscle-memory shell, in-process dispatch)

tools.name: project.status
tools.description: Project DB status: db path, layer count, visible layers, feature count, CRS values in use (SQLite project DB; db optional)

tools.name: layer.add
tools.description: Add a layer: id, name required; source, geom_type, crs, visible, db optional

tools.name: layer.list
tools.description: List layers in draw order (SQLite project DB; db optional)

tools.name: layer.remove
tools.description: Remove a layer by id (db optional)

tools.name: layer.color
tools.description: Set a layer display color: id required, color #rrggbb (empty clears to palette), db optional

tools.name: geocode.search
tools.description: Search places: query required, limit 1..50, live=false demo else Photon

tools.name: overpass.query
tools.description: Overpass tag search: key/value required, bbox south/west/north/east optional, live=false dry-runs QL else executes; ingest=true writes hits to db

tools.name: features.list
tools.description: List ingested point features, optionally filtered to one layer (db optional)

tools.name: layer.import
tools.description: Import a GeoJSON/CSV file as a layer: format auto-detected by extension or explicit (geojson|csv); layer_id defaults to the file stem; persists to db

tools.name: processing.buffer
tools.description: Buffer point features of a layer into circle polygons: layer_id required; distance (meters, default 200.0), segments (8..256, default 24), output_layer, db optional

tools.name: processing.grid
tools.description: Build a rect or hex grid over a bbox: south/west/north/east required; cell_size meters (default 500), hex flag, output_layer, db optional; persists to db

tools.name: processing.nearest
tools.description: Nearest-neighbor join: hub lines from source_layer to closest target_layer feature; output_layer, db optional; persists to db

tools.name: processing.geodesic
tools.description: True-distance shape: circle (radius_m), ellipse (major_m/minor_m/bearing_deg) or line (lng2/lat2) around lng/lat; segments, output_layer, db optional; persists to db

tools.name: map.forge
tools.description: Forge a map from a MapSpec JSON file: path required; live=false dry-runs QL per layer else executes; ingest=true writes live hits to db

tools.name: wkt.show
tools.description: Show WKT geometry as a layer: wkt required (POINT/LINESTRING/POLYGON + MULTI, 2D only); layer_id, db optional; persists to db

tools.name: doppler.locate
tools.description: Doppler geolocation: rank grid candidates by matching curves to ADS-B tracks; path to capture JSON required; bbox, step_deg, top_n, terrain_m, output_layer, db optional; persists top candidates to db
